##Use the "anchor date" strategy to fix the timeline in memory  
The document specifies the start (2 July) and end (6 September) dates, with the final on 2 September. Anchor these dates in your memory using a mental timeline. For example, imagine a calendar where 2 July is the start of a journey, and 2 September is the climax. Associate each stage (rounds) with a date or event in that range, such as "first round in mid-July" or "semi-finals in early August." This strengthens chronological recall and makes it easier to remember the sequence.
